Title: Critical Environment Operations Manager - Data Center
Description:
**Overview**
Microsoft’s Cloud Infrastructure and Operations (MCIO) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a
**Critical Environment Operations Manager**
, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform.
  
  
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
  
  
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Empower a culture of safety, security, and compliance in all aspects of our Datacenter operations
* Lead a team of Mechanical, Electrical and Control System professionals supporting Microsoft's online services
* Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our Datacenters
* Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability to ensure optimal operational efficiency
* Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year
* Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives
* Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring
* Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and business partners
* Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio

**Qualifications**
Required/minimum qualifications
  
  

* High School Qualification or equivalent AND 3+ years experience of mission-critical service management (e.g., Data Centers, military, hospitals, power plants, etc. or managing physical operations and/or critical environment infrastructure) OR equivalent experience.

**Background Check Requirements**
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  
  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter
* The successful candidate currently has the ability to obtain Reliability Status screening from a duly authorized department or agency of the Government of Canada. This process includes but is not limited to:

+ Verification of identity, background, education, professional credentials, personal and professional references, credit check and criminal background check.
+ Reliability Status screening may also require a security questionnaire and security interview.
+ To obtain the requisite clearance within required timelines, applicants must have five (5) years of continuous Canadian residency and must not have lived or worked outside of Canada for more than six (6) months during that time unless Microsoft is satisfied that the requisite clearance can nevertheless be obtained within required timelines.

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Technical College Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering,or related field AND 8+ years experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), OR High School Qualification or equivalent AND 10+ years experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), OR equivalent experience.
* 1+ year(s) people management experience.
* 3+ years experience in leading a diverse, technical team.
* Applicable certifications: ITIL v3 Foundation, Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF) Certifications, Leadership Development Certifications, PMP.
* Experience working on large scale CE projects.

Title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Global Submarine Networks Landing Stations Build
Description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Reston, VA, USA; New York, NY, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.
* 8 years of experience in engineering design, technical program management, or infrastructure delivery focused on Cable Landing Stations (CLS), hyperscale data centers, or telecommunications facilities.
* 5 years of experience in leadership role with/without direct reports.
* 5 years of experience with submarine cable system landing infrastructure, including experience with beach manholes (BMH), terrestrial front-haul duct routes, Ocean Ground Bed (OGB) earthing systems, and Power Feed Equipment (PFE) room requirements.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Infrastructure Management, accompanied by an active Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer (CEng), or equivalent international engineering licensure.
* Experience in bidding, designing, operating, and commissioning of mission critical systems.
* Expertise navigating coastal zoning, nearshore geophysical hazards, seismicity, flood resilience, environmental impact assessments (EIA), and marine permit constraints impacting landing station design.
* Strong background in technical due diligence, utility infrastructure assessments, vendor contract negotiations, and managing multi-million-dollar capital expenditure budgets (CapEx) alongside operating budgets (OpEx).

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Direct, mentor, and grow a multi-disciplinary team of global engineering SMEs and technical program managers responsible for land due diligence, facility engineering, and construction delivery.
* Establish and manage design frameworks, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) protocols, stage gate project execution procedures, and programmatic delivery standards for Cable Landing Stations globally.
* Manage portfolio of technical due diligence evaluations on greenfield land parcels and existing facility assets worldwide, evaluating civil, geotechnical, environmental, power, and marine approach suitability for new landing stations.
* Evaluate design delivery models in conjunction with construction execution and contracting methodologies to derisk project delivery and accelerate portfolio execution while maintaining design quality assurance.
* Lead teams responsible for technical field administration during construction execution, including managing Requests for Information (RFIs), submittal reviews, design field changes, and construction quality inspections.

Title: Cloud Infrastructure Manager
Description:
Cloud Infrastructure Manager
  
**The role**

Lead the cloud infrastructure that runs myZoi’s production platforms across AWS and Azure, keeping them reliable, secure, scalable and cost-effective.

This is a player-coach role. You will manage the DevOps and SRE team while staying hands-on in design, implementation and incident response, with particular depth in cloud and infrastructure networking.

You will own the infrastructure roadmap, operational performance and delivery of improvements. You will work closely with Architecture, Engineering, Cybersecurity and Technology Operations to support business growth and maintain service continuity.

Key responsibilities
  
  
Team leadership
  
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the DevOps and SRE team; set clear objectives and manage performance.
* Plan priorities across operational work, improvements and projects, with clear owners, milestones and escalation of risks.
* Build on-call arrangements, backup coverage and knowledge sharing so no service depends on a single engineer; take part in the escalation rota.
* Report proactively on service health, delivery progress, costs and material risks.

Hands-on infrastructure and networking
  
  
  

* Design, build and operate cloud networking across AWS and Azure, including VPC/VNet design, hub-and-spoke or transit topologies, routing, DNS, load balancing, private endpoints and hybrid connectivity (VPN, AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute).
* Implement network security controls, including segmentation, firewalls, security groups and NSGs, WAF and secure ingress and egress.
* Build and operate compute, storage, managed databases and Kubernetes platforms, with clear segregation of production and non-production environments.
* Write and review Terraform, and set standards for configuration management, patching and lifecycle management using version control, peer review and automated checks.
* Develop infrastructure designs with Architecture and implement the agreed standards.
* Lead the technical planning and execution of migrations and infrastructure transitions, including testing, cutover, rollback and handover.

DevOps and reliability
  
  
  

* Oversee infrastructure automation, deployment tooling and CI/CD in partnership with Engineering.
* Improve monitoring, observability and actionable alerting; agree service-level objectives with service owners.
* Own infrastructure-level escalation and restoration during incidents, then drive root-cause analysis and lasting fixes.
* Maintain capacity and performance plans aligned with expected demand.

Backup and disaster recovery
  
  
  

* Own infrastructure backup, restore and recovery mechanisms.
* Plan and run recovery tests with Technology Operations and application owners, validating agreed RTO and RPO targets.

Security and compliance
  
  
  

* Implement cloud security controls in line with Cybersecurity policies, including identity and privileged access, encryption, logging and secrets management.
* Ensure vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses are remediated within agreed timelines.
* Apply regulatory, data-residency and contractual requirements to infrastructure, with guidance from the responsible functions.
* Maintain current infrastructure documentation, recovery procedures and auditable records of access, changes, control operation and test results; support internal and external reviews.

Cost and supplier management
  
  
  

* Manage cloud spend within approved budgets, with transparent allocation, forecasting and reporting.
* Drive cost optimisation through rightsizing, commitment-based purchasing and removal of unused resources.
* Manage the technical performance of cloud and infrastructure suppliers, supporting commercial decisions with Finance and Procurement.

Experience and capabilities
  

* Typically 8 or more years in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps or related disciplines, including at least 3 years managing engineers.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams that run business-critical production services, while remaining hands-on.
* Strong hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure. Experience with cross-cloud migration is advantageous.
* Deep networking expertise across cloud and hybrid environments: TCP/IP, routing, subnetting, DNS, load balancing, VPN and private connectivity, firewalls and segmentation, and troubleshooting complex connectivity issues.
* Practical expertise in identity and access management, Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability.
* Experience with disaster recovery testing, major incidents, infrastructure security and cost optimisation.
* Ability to challenge technical proposals, prioritise competing demands and explain decisions in clear business terms.
* Proven delivery through internal teams and external suppliers, with effective delegation and proactive escalation.
* Financial-services, payments or other regulated-sector experience is preferred.

Qualifications
  

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Relevant AWS, Azure, Terraform or Kubernetes certifications are desirable.
* Networking certifications (for example AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer Associate or CCNP) are a plus.
* Familiarity with ITIL and recognised security frameworks is advantageous.

Title: Network Security Lead- Cloud Infrastructure
Description:
**Job Description**
Own the end-to-end architecture, design, deployment, and 24/7 operational management of secure network and security infrastructure across cloud (Azure, GCP, OCI) and on-premises environments — spanning routing, switching, and cybersecurity engineering. Act as the technical authority responsible for designing highly available, resilient architectures; leading deployment and configuration of new environments; and operating the infrastructure around the clock to ensure it remains stable, secure, and audit-ready. Skilled in preparing operational reports and presentations, running operational meetings, handling escalations, and managing major changes — while retaining hands-on accountability for daily operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design secure reference architectures for hub-spoke topologies, VNet/VPC/VCN environments, subnetting, IP/CIDR planning, and static/BGP dynamic routing across Azure, GCP, and OCI, as well as on-prem routing and switching infrastructure.
* Architect secure connectivity patterns — VPN, peering, and dedicated interconnects (ExpressRoute, Interconnect, FastConnect) — and lead network security design reviews with actionable, best-practice recommendations.
* Lead deployment and configuration of network security environments: Site-to-Site VPNs with redundant tunnels and BGP routing, VPC/VCN peering, NSGs, security lists/ACLs, NVAs, next-gen firewalls, and Internet/NAT/Service Gateways for new builds and migrations.
* Design, deploy, and operate infrastructure to meet 24/7 availability targets, including redundancy, failover, load balancing, and disaster recovery across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Own round-the-clock operational management of the network and security environment: change management, patching/upgrades of NVAs, vulnerability tracking and remediation, and coordination of patch windows and incident response.
* Manage and oversee day-to-day network and security operations across routing, switching, and cybersecurity engineering, keeping leadership informed of status, risks, and escalations.
* Configure and maintain monitoring, logging, and diagnostics (Azure Monitor, GCP Cloud Monitoring, OCI Monitoring, flow logs) to proactively detect and resolve availability, performance, and security issues.
* Harden network device and cloud configurations against industry benchmarks (e.g., CIS, NIST) and internal security baselines; remediate findings from internal/external audits.
* Prepare and present operational reports, dashboards, and presentations summarizing network/security performance, availability, incidents, and risk posture to leadership and stakeholders.
* Plan and run operational meetings — daily/weekly stand-ups, service reviews, and incident review sessions — driving action items to closure.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical operational and security issues across all managed platforms, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication.
* Own and handle major changes end-to-end — planning, risk assessment, change advisory board (CAB) submissions, implementation, and post-change validation — with minimal impact to 24/7 availability.
* Design, deploy, and validate backup and restore procedures for NVAs, firewall policies, and network configuration state; own disaster recovery and cross-region DR networking design.
* Coordinate cross-functional activities with cloud, security, application, and operations teams to ensure consistent security posture and always-on availability across the environment.
* Maintain accurate architecture documentation, network diagrams, runbooks, and operational procedures; ensure changes follow proper governance, risk, and change-control processes.
* Mentor engineers and act as a point of technical escalation for complex operational or security issues.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and respond to critical incidents outside business hours to maintain 24/7 availability; travel to datacenter or client sites as needed.

**Qualifications**

* 10–12 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, network operations, and cybersecurity engineering, including hands-on ownership of designing, deploying, and operating secure network infrastructure.
* Demonstrable depth across at least two of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (all three strongly preferred).
* Proven experience designing and operating infrastructure to meet 24/7 availability, redundancy, and disaster recovery requirements.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing or coordinating multi-disciplinary operations (network + security) and reporting outcomes to leadership.
* Strong skills in preparing operational reports, dashboards, and presentations for leadership and stakeholder audiences.
* Proven track record running operational meetings and driving structured escalation handling to resolution.
* Hands-on experience managing major changes, including change planning, risk assessment, CAB processes, and post-implementation review.
* Hands-on expertise with enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, NVAs, and cloud-native network security monitoring tools.
* Experience hardening network and cloud infrastructure against security frameworks and remediating audit findings.
* Strong troubleshooting and incident-response experience across routing, switching, cloud networking, and security domains.
* Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to work closely with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Willing and able to participate in an on-call rotation and travel to datacenter/client sites as needed to maintain 24/7 availability.

**Required Certifications**

* Cisco CCNP (Enterprise / Security) or equivalent vendor-neutral routing & switching certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Security Engineer Associate (or Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
* Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer / Cloud Security Engineer.
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Network Security Professional or Architect Professional.
* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) or working toward certification.
* Firewall/NGFW vendor certification (e.g., Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE, Fortinet NSE, or Check Point CCSA/CCSE).

*Preferred: CCIE, CISM, CEH. At least two of Azure, GCP, and OCI required; all three strongly preferred. Certifications must be current; equivalent recognized credentials considered subject to approval.*

**Network Platform Lead**

**Role Summary**

The Network Platform Lead is the single accountable leader for the Texas Private Cloud Network Platform and its outcomes across strategy, engineering, operations, service delivery, modernization, capacity, security, financial performance, and workforce capability.  
The role owns the network as an integrated platform rather than a collection of individual technologies or operational teams. Its mission is to provide reliable, secure, scalable, automated, and measurable connectivity services that enable every other TPC platform and the State of Texas agencies that depend upon them.

The Network Platform encompasses network operations and architecture execution, routing and switching, firewalls, load balancing, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, VPN, network automation, data-center connectivity, and specialized network fabrics. These are managed as platform capabilities and customer-consumable services rather than isolated technology silos.

The Network Platform Lead sets the direction for evolving this environment from primarily device- and ticket-oriented network operations toward a standardized, software-defined, automated, observable, and service-oriented network platform.  
Success is measured not simply by whether network devices are operational, but by whether applications, infrastructure platforms and agencies receive the connectivity, availability, performance, security, capacity and speed of delivery they require.  
  
Key Accountabilities  
Platform Strategy & Roadmap  
Own the Network Platform strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned with TPC modernization priorities, CTO architecture direction, customer requirements and the roadmaps of Compute, Data, AI, Mainframe and Data Center platforms.  
Translate architectural direction into an executable network platform roadmap spanning Run, Change and Evolve.  
Define the evolution of routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing, DNS/DHCP/IPAM, VPN, data-center fabrics and emerging software-defined networking capabilities.

Establish clear connectivity standards and drive adoption of reusable network services rather than bespoke configurations.  
Maintain a prioritized platform backlog balancing availability, technical debt, lifecycle, security, automation, capacity, customer demand and modernization.

Network Operations & Reliability  
Be accountable for the end-to-end health, availability and performance of the Network Platform, including 24x7 operations.  
Own operational outcomes across incidents, problems, changes, configuration, firmware, maintenance and network service restoration.  
Meet or exceed contractual network availability and service-level commitments.  
Establish meaningful SLIs, SLOs and KPIs for availability, latency, packet loss, capacity, change quality, incidents and service-request performance.  
Drive permanent elimination of recurring network incidents and chronic conditions rather than allowing repetitive operational work to become normalized.  
Improve resilience and fault tolerance across network paths, devices and critical connectivity services.  
Lead TPC's network response during major incidents affecting network services and participate in TxDIR-convened MIRTs when Network owns the affected service. This follows TPC's model where incident execution accountability remains with the platform that owns the affected service.

Network Engineering & Automation  
Transform network delivery from predominantly manual device configuration toward policy-driven, repeatable and automated network services.  
Establish standard configuration and deployment patterns for network capabilities.  
Expand Infrastructure-as-Code and Network-as-Code practices for configuration, validation and lifecycle activities.  
Automate high-volume and repeatable network workflows, particularly provisioning, configuration validation, compliance, changes and service requests.  
Introduce automated pre-change and post-change validation to reduce change-related incidents.  
Partner with Platform Engineering & Automation to build reusable pipelines, workflows, integrations and self-service capabilities rather than creating isolated automation inside Network. TPC's target operating model explicitly places shared automation with Platform Engineering while platforms remain accountable for operating their services.  
Reduce network fulfillment time and manual effort while improving configuration consistency and auditability.

Modernization & Lifecycle  
Own the Network Platform modernization roadmap across hardware, software, firmware, network services and management tooling.  
Maintain an actionable lifecycle plan covering routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers and other network-owned appliances.  
Identify technical debt, obsolescence, capacity constraints, unsupported versions and architectural limitations before they create service or security risks.  
Drive upgrades and technology refreshes toward strategic standards instead of maintaining unnecessary technology variants.  
Treat network modernization as an ongoing platform responsibility rather than an episodic refresh program.  
Own firmware lifecycle for network devices including firewalls, routers, switches, load balancers and fabric switches, consistent with TPC's defined technical-ownership model.  
Connectivity Services & Customer Experience  
Treat firewall, load-balancing, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, VPN and other connectivity capabilities as services, each with clear ownership, standards and measurable outcomes.  
Make network services easier to understand, request, provision, change and support.  
Reduce fulfillment times for common network requests through standard patterns and automation.  
Establish service owners for significant cataloged Network services as the catalog evolves. Under the TPC ownership model, service ownership is an assigned responsibility beneath the Platform Lead rather than necessarily a management position.  
Reduce unnecessary customer-specific network implementations where a secure, supportable shared pattern can meet the requirement.

Capacity & Performance  
Own Network capacity, including bandwidth and port capacity, while Operations Intelligence provides enterprise-level forecasting, trending and cross-platform visibility.  
Maintain forward-looking network capacity plans based on utilization, growth, customer demand and platform roadmaps.  
Establish thresholds and triggers so capacity constraints are addressed before they affect service.  
Provide Network capacity requirements into broader TPC planning for Compute, Data, AI and Data Center infrastructure.  
Ensure monitoring provides actionable visibility into congestion, saturation, latency, packet loss and other indicators of network health.

Security & Compliance  
Own the Network Platform's implementation of required security controls, configuration standards and vulnerability remediation in partnership with the CISO organization.  
Maintain secure configurations and lifecycle discipline across network-managed infrastructure.  
Drive vulnerability remediation and eliminate unsupported or security-risk technologies.  
Incorporate security controls into standard network patterns and automation wherever practical.  
Partner with Security on firewall and network-control requirements while maintaining clear separation between security governance/risk ownership and operational execution. TPC's target model assigns policy, risk and GRC to the CISO while platforms execute remediation and operate their infrastructure.

Cross-Platform Enablement  
Network is foundational to virtually every TPC service. The Network Platform Lead therefore owns the Network side of critical cross-platform capabilities, including:  
Compute and VMware connectivity.  
OpenShift and container networking.  
Storage and Data Platform connectivity.  
Backup, replication and DR network paths.  
Mainframe connectivity.  
Data Center physical network infrastructure dependencies.  
AI/GPU networking and fabric.  
Tenant segmentation and network isolation.  
For AI specifically, Network owns the GPU fabric, tenant network isolation and fabric-switch firmware, while other portions of the GPU stack remain with AI, Compute and Data Center.  
This requires the Network Platform Lead to operate as a peer platform owner, not as a downstream fulfillment team receiving tickets from the other platforms.  
Service & Customer Leadership  
Represent the Network Platform to DIR, the MSI, Texas agencies, other STS providers and strategic technology partners.  
Translate customer requirements into scalable platform capabilities and roadmap priorities.  
Own network-related customer escalations and ensure systemic issues result in corrective action.  
Provide clear visibility into platform health, lifecycle, capacity, security posture and roadmap.  
Maintain customer relationships for the Network Platform as part of the defined Platform Lead model. Platform Leads remain customer-facing under the current TPC target organization.

People & Capability Leadership  
Lead and develop the Network organization across Network Operations, engineering and architecture execution, while preserving specialized technical capabilities where appropriate.  
Evolve skills from traditional network administration toward network automation, Infrastructure-as-Code, software-defined networking, observability, API integration and SRE practices.  
Build sufficient technical depth and succession coverage for critical networking technologies.  
Develop modern networking skills required by emerging platforms, particularly OpenShift/container networking and GPU/AI network fabrics.  
Establish clear accountability across operations, engineering, architecture implementation and service ownership.  
Build an engineering culture focused on standardization, automation, measurable reliability and continuous improvement.

What the Network Platform Lead Owns

The Network Platform Lead is ultimately accountable for:  
Platform health | Connectivity | Network availability & performance | Customer experience | Platform roadmap | Capacity | Lifecycle | Network automation | Technical debt | Security posture | Service standardization | Network service delivery | Workforce capability | Continuous improvement  
The role does not simply manage network devices, engineers or ticket queues.  
It owns the Network Platform as a foundational TPC capability and is accountable for how well that platform performs today, how efficiently customers consume its services, and how it evolves to support TPC's future Compute, Data and AI services.

Experience & Capabilities  
Significant leadership experience operating large-scale enterprise or service-provider network environments in an SLA-driven environment, preferably public sector or another highly regulated environment.  
Strong understanding of enterprise routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, VPN and data-center networking.  
Experience with highly available data-center network architectures and network segmentation.  
Practical understanding of network automation, APIs, Infrastructure-as-Code, configuration management, Git-based workflows and automated validation.  
Understanding of modern container and Kubernetes/OpenShift networking.  
Ability to develop capability around emerging high-performance Ethernet/GPU fabrics required by AI services. TPC's target model explicitly places GPU fabric and network isolation with Network.  
Strong ITIL/service-management knowledge and experience operating with ServiceNow in a multi-supplier model, particularly important because the MSI owns and operates ServiceNow as the common STS system of record.  
Strong capacity, lifecycle and vendor-management discipline.  
Working knowledge of security, vulnerability management and regulatory/compliance requirements.  
Ability to translate technical strategy into an executable platform roadmap with measurable outcomes.  
Strong leadership and workforce-development capabilities, including transitioning traditional network operations toward platform engineering and automation.  
Executive-level communication skills and the ability to represent the platform credibly with DIR, agencies, vendors and internal leadership.

Definition of Success  
A successful Network Platform Lead progressively creates an environment where:  
Network availability and performance are predictable and measurable.  
Recurring network incidents decline.  
Network changes become safer and increasingly automated.  
Firewall and connectivity fulfillment times materially improve.  
Standard network patterns replace unnecessary bespoke configurations.  
Capacity constraints are identified before customers experience them.  
Configuration drift and manual errors decline.  
Lifecycle and security risks are actively driven down.  
Network services become increasingly API-driven and self-service capable.  
Network supports Compute, Data, AI and the other platforms as a strategic enabler rather than a ticket-driven dependency.  
Engineers spend less time performing repetitive configuration and more time improving the platform.  
The Network Platform has a clear roadmap, measurable health and one accountable owner.

Title: Incident Manager
Description:
Koniag IT Systems, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an Incident Manager to support KITS and our government customer Washington, DC. The position is hybrid, requires 3 days onsite. This position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a Public Trust.
  
Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.
  
Koniag IT Systems, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an experienced Incident Manager to support a comprehensive enterprise IT operations and support engagement for a federal customer. This role serves as the primary owner of the enterprise incident management lifecycle, ensuring rapid detection, triage, escalation, resolution, and post-incident review of IT incidents across a geographically distributed, 24x7 hybrid on-premises and cloud environment spanning AWS commercial and GovCloud, Microsoft 365, Azure Government, and enterprise network and application platforms.
  
  
The Incident Manager operates within a mature ITIL 4-aligned IT Service Management (ITSM) practice and works in close coordination with the enterprise NOC, multi-tier Service Desk, network engineering, infrastructure, and platform operations teams to ensure that all incidents are managed to resolution within established service level objectives. This individual plays a central role in driving service restoration, minimizing business impact, and contributing to the program's continual service improvement objectives through trend analysis, problem identification, and post-incident learning activities.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented and operationally experienced ITSM professional with a strong background in enterprise incident management, ITIL-based service management practices, and federal IT operations environments. This individual must thrive in a fast-paced, high-accountability 24x7 operational setting and possess the ability to coordinate effectively across diverse technical teams and Government stakeholders under time-critical conditions.
  
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain an SBA background investigation, HSPD-12 PIV credentials, and applicable IT access authorizations prior to performing work. This position may be primarily performed at SBA Headquarters and/or approved remote/telework locations.
  
  
The Incident Manager is responsible for owning and managing the end-to-end enterprise incident management lifecycle in accordance with ITIL 4 best practices and SBA OCIO service management requirements. This individual ensures that all incidents—from Tier 1 Service Desk tickets through Priority 1 critical enterprise outages—are accurately classified, prioritized, assigned, escalated, and resolved within established service level agreements (SLAs). The Incident Manager serves as the central coordination hub during major incidents, driving technical bridge calls, managing stakeholder communications, and ensuring timely service restoration. This role also contributes to problem management, change management support, knowledge management, and continual service improvement activities.
  
  
Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:
  
  
**Incident Lifecycle Management:**  

* Own and manage the full enterprise incident management lifecycle from initial detection and logging through triage, categorization, prioritization, assignment, escalation, resolution, and formal closure in the Government's ITSM platform.
* Ensure all incidents are accurately classified by priority (P1–P4) in accordance with established impact and urgency criteria, and that appropriate response and resolution timelines are applied and monitored in real time.
* Monitor the active incident queue continuously, identifying aging incidents, escalation triggers, SLA breach risks, and stalled assignments, and taking proactive action to ensure forward progress on all open incidents.
* Coordinate and drive the timely assignment of incidents to the appropriate Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, or Tier 4 technical resources based on incident category, complexity, and required expertise.
* Ensure incidents are escalated promptly and appropriately—both functionally across technical teams and hierarchically to program leadership and Government stakeholders—when SLA thresholds, scope, or business impact warrant escalation.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and timely incident records in the ITSM platform throughout the incident lifecycle, ensuring all actions, decisions, workarounds, and resolutions are thoroughly documented.

**Major Incident Management:**  

* Serve as the primary coordinator and decision-maker for all Priority 1 (P1) and Priority 2 (P2) major incidents, activating and leading technical bridge calls, war rooms, and cross-functional response teams to drive rapid service restoration.
* Ensure P1 critical incidents are acknowledged within 15 minutes and that service restoration is achieved within 4 hours in accordance with program service level objectives, meeting the Government's target of at least 90% of P1 incidents restored within the 4-hour SLA.
* Maintain clear, accurate, and timely stakeholder communications throughout major incident events, including initial notifications, status updates at defined intervals, and formal incident closure notifications to the COR and Government stakeholders.
* Coordinate with the NOC, Service Desk Manager, technical leads, and program leadership to ensure all required resources are engaged, barriers to resolution are removed, and escalation paths are followed during major incidents.
* Lead or facilitate formal post-incident reviews (PIRs) for all P1 and significant P2 incidents, ensuring root cause analysis findings, contributing factors, corrective actions, and lessons learned are thoroughly documented and tracked to completion.

**Problem Management Coordination:**  

* Collaborate with the Problem Manager or Service Management Lead to ensure incidents exhibiting patterns of recurrence or systemic root causes are formally transitioned into the problem management process.
* Contribute incident trend data, recurring issue patterns, and workaround documentation to support problem record creation, root cause investigation, and known error documentation.
* Track and monitor the implementation of permanent fixes and corrective actions arising from problem management activities, ensuring incident recurrence rates are measurably reduced over time.

**Change Management Support:**  

* Coordinate with the change management process to identify incidents resulting from unauthorized changes or failed changes, ensuring accurate linkage between incident records and associated change records in the ITSM platform.
* Participate in Change Advisory Board (CAB) activities as needed, providing incident trend data and operational risk inputs to support change impact assessment and scheduling decisions.

**ITSM Platform Administration & Reporting:**  

* Administer and maintain incident management workflows, categorization schemas, assignment group structures, escalation rules, and SLA configurations within the Government's ITSM platform (ServiceNow or equivalent) to ensure accurate and efficient incident processing.
* Develop, maintain, and deliver recurring incident management performance reports and dashboards, including metrics on incident volumes, SLA compliance rates, mean time to acknowledge (MTTA), mean time to resolve (MTTR), first-contact resolution rates, escalation rates, and incident trends by category and priority.
* Contribute incident management metrics and performance data to Sprint Review Reports, Monthly Status and Performance Reports, and the service-level/ITSM metrics dashboard submitted to the Government by the 5th business day of each month.
* Analyze incident data to identify trends, high-volume categories, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities, providing actionable recommendations to program leadership and the Service Management Lead.

**Knowledge Management:**  

* Oversee the development, review, and maintenance of incident-related knowledge base articles, resolution guides, troubleshooting procedures, and known error workarounds in the Government's ITSM knowledge management system.
* Ensure Tier 1 and Tier 2 Service Desk personnel have access to current, accurate, and actionable knowledge base content to support first-contact resolution objectives, targeting at least 70% of eligible tickets resolved at Tier 1.
* Promote a knowledge-sharing culture across the NOC and Service Desk, ensuring resolution documentation is captured at ticket closure and that institutional knowledge is preserved throughout personnel transitions.

**Agile Delivery Integration:**  

* Participate in Sprint ceremonies as required, including Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, and Sprint Retrospectives, contributing incident management workstream priorities, improvement backlog items, and operational performance data to the Sprint cadence.
* Maintain and manage incident management-related backlog items in the Government's Agile/ITSM tooling, ensuring items are accurately prioritized, estimated, and tracked to completion each Sprint.
* Identify and propose process improvement opportunities for inclusion in the program backlog, driving measurable enhancements to incident management efficiency, SLA performance, and customer satisfaction.

**Security & Compliance:**  

* Ensure all incident management activities comply with applicable Federal security, privacy, and compliance requirements, including FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, SBA IT and cybersecurity policies, and CUI safeguarding requirements.
* Ensure suspected or confirmed security incidents are promptly identified, escalated, and reported in accordance with SBA incident response procedures and applicable Federal reporting requirements.
* Support the application of least-privilege, separation-of-duties, and Zero Trust principles within incident management workflows and access control practices.

**Education and Experience:****Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field from an accredited college or university. Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT service management, with at least 3 years of dedicated experience in an Incident Manager, Major Incident Manager, or equivalent ITSM leadership role in an enterprise federal IT environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing the full incident lifecycle—including P1 major incident coordination—in a 24x7 enterprise IT operations environment of comparable scale and complexity.
* Demonstrated experience with ITIL-based ITSM practices, including incident management, problem management, change management, and knowledge management.

Title: Lead ICT Engineer - Data Centers
Description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Lead ICT Engineer is responsible for leading the Information and Communications Technology engineering scope of Digital EPC projects from concept and detailed design through procurement, construction, systems integration, testing, commissioning and final handover. The role ensures that ICT infrastructure, telecommunications systems, data-centre connectivity, structured cabling, active networks, wireless solutions and unified communications platforms are secure, resilient, scalable and aligned with project and operational requirements.

The position provides discipline leadership for data centres, ICT facilities, telecommunications hubs, smart buildings, command-and-control centres and other technology-intensive developments. The Lead ICT Engineer coordinates engineers, designers, specialist consultants, OEMs, vendors, construction teams, systems integrators and client representatives while managing interfaces with power, cooling, ELV, security, BMS, DCIM and commissioning functions.

The role safeguards engineering quality and connectivity resilience through disciplined architecture governance, capacity planning, cybersecurity integration, equipment specification, vendor review, configuration control and change management. It resolves complex technical issues and ensures that ICT systems support integrated testing, operational readiness, business continuity and long-term maintainability.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. ICT Engineering Leadership**

Lead planning, execution and technical assurance of the ICT engineering scope, establishing architecture principles, delivery priorities, resource requirements, design schedules and quality expectations.

**2. ICT Infrastructure Architecture**

Develop and govern end-to-end ICT architecture covering data networks, structured cabling, telecommunications, wireless connectivity, data-centre infrastructure and unified communications.

**3. Network & Connectivity Engineering**

Lead design of LAN, WAN, WLAN, fiber-optic backbones, campus networks, internet connectivity and mission-critical communications, ensuring capacity, redundancy, availability and scalability.

**4. Structured Cabling & Passive Infrastructure**

Direct design and coordination of copper and fiber structured cabling, pathways, containment, equipment rooms, racks, cabinets, patching, labeling, testing and certification requirements.

**5. Telecommunications & Unified Communications**

Provide technical leadership for IP telephony, unified communications, video collaboration, operational communications and associated telecom infrastructure and interfaces.

**6. Cybersecurity & Network Resilience Integration**

Embed segmentation, secure architecture, access control, redundancy, monitoring, hardening and cybersecurity requirements into ICT designs in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

**7. Vendor & Procurement Engineering**

Prepare and review specifications, datasheets, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, vendor documents, deviations and clarifications for ICT equipment, software, licensing and services.

**8. Multidiscipline & Systems Integration Coordination**

Manage interfaces with ELV, security, audiovisual, BMS, DCIM, power, cooling, civil, architectural, construction and commissioning disciplines to deliver integrated solutions.

**9. Construction, Testing & Commissioning Support**

Resolve technical queries and field issues and lead readiness for factory and site testing, cable certification, network validation, failover testing, integrated systems testing and defect closure.

**10. Documentation, Handover & Team Development**

Ensure completion of configurations, asset records, as-built drawings, test evidence, operating manuals, training and handover documentation while guiding ICT engineers and designers

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**

**ICT Engineering Experience: Minimum 12+ years in design and project delivery**

Progressive experience in ICT networks, telecommunications, structured cabling and digital infrastructure for data centres, smart buildings, transport, utilities or technology-intensive EPC projects.

**Discipline Leadership Experience: Minimum 5+ years leading ICT engineering teams**

Demonstrated responsibility for architecture, technical deliverables, equipment packages, vendor coordination, multidisciplinary interfaces, systems integration and engineering quality.

**Digital EPC & Commissioning Experience: Minimum 5+ years across procurement, construction and testing**

Experience translating ICT requirements into vendor packages, installation deliverables, configurations, testing procedures and operational-handover solutions.

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**

**1. Enterprise Network Architecture**

Advanced knowledge of LAN, WAN, WLAN, routing, switching, network segmentation, redundancy, availability and capacity planning for complex digital environments.

**2. Structured Cabling & Data-Centre Connectivity**

Strong understanding of copper and fiber cabling, pathways, spaces, racks, cabinets, patching, labeling, testing, certification and data-centre connectivity principles.

**3. Telecommunications & Unified Communications**

Knowledge of IP telephony, unified communications, video collaboration, operational communications and related infrastructure, protocols and integration requirements.

**4. Cybersecurity, Configuration & Systems Integration**

Ability to incorporate secure architecture, access controls, monitoring, configuration management and interfaces with ELV, BMS, DCIM, security and operational systems.

**5. Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

Strong analytical, communication and decision-making capability to resolve complex ICT issues, lead technical teams and align clients, consultants, OEMs and integrators.

**EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS**

• Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related discipline

• Professional Engineering registration, chartered status, or equivalent professional qualification preferred

• Relevant advanced networking certification such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE, Juniper JNCIP/JNCIE, or equivalent strongly preferred

• Relevant certification in structured cabling, data centres, wireless, unified communications, cybersecurity, or project management advantageous

• Training in applicable international ICT standards, systems integration, HSE, or quality management preferred

**TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES**

**Enterprise Network Design:**

Designs and reviews resilient LAN, WAN, WLAN, routing, switching, segmentation, addressing, capacity and high-availability architectures.

**Structured Cabling & Fiber Infrastructure:**

Leads design and verification of copper and fiber systems, containment, equipment rooms, racks, labeling, testing and certification.

Engineers IP telephony, collaboration, video, operational communications and associated platform and connectivity requirements.

**Cybersecurity & Configuration Governance:**

Applies secure architecture, access control, hardening, monitoring, configuration, change and technical-documentation controls throughout delivery.

Develops and governs test plans, network validation, failover testing, integrated systems testing, defect resolution and operational acceptance.

Title: Network Operations Manager
Description:
**About Us**
Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.
  
  
**About The Role**
Effortless is looking for a Network Operations Manager who is an excellent leader and engineer. This is a player-coach role: you will lead our network engineering team while remaining one of the company's top escalation and design resources for enterprise, high-availability, multi-platform networks.
  
  
You will own the health, security, and continuous improvement of the networks we manage for our customers and within our own Switch data center infrastructure. We expect you to be proactive: you will not wait for tickets. You and your team will regularly review client environments, find risk, capacity, and performance gaps before they become outages, and bring clear, cost-effective recommendations to our customers and Service Delivery Teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. You set a high standard, communicate clearly, take ownership, and care about the customer experience.
  
  
**Position Details**
**Reports to:**
President
  
  
**Direct reports:**
Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers
  
  
**Location:**
Remote with a preference for someone in/near Las Vegas, NV.
  
  
**Travel:**
Some travel required for data center work, client site visits, and special projects.
  
  
**Schedule:**
Monday - Friday 8:00-5:00 PST, with 24/7 escalation availability for major incidents and management of the team's on-call rotation.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K + employer match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for career growth and development
* Training and certification support

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Serves as the company's senior network engineering authority and final escalation point in core routing and switching, network security, and network diagnostics.
* Designs, reviews, and approves complex network configurations and architecture, including hardware and software technology, site locations, business continuity, disaster recovery, and integration of technologies.
* Personally assesses and resolves the most complex data network problems and incidents, and leads major incident response through to resolution and root cause analysis.
* Owns the design, standards, and lifecycle of Effortless's own network infrastructure at our Switch data centers, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SDWAN (Meraki and Cisco Viptela) environments.
* Sets and maintains network engineering standards, configuration baselines, and documentation requirements in IT Glue, and reviews the team's work for quality and consistency.
* Reviews analyses and technical feasibility to develop data network deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates.

Proactive Client Improvement
  
  

* Leads a regular program of proactive network reviews across client environments to find security, reliability, capacity, and performance gaps before they cause issues.
* Uses Auvik monitoring, ticket trends in Autotask, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and drive permanent fixes rather than repeated reactive work.
* Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements.
* Partners with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, and ESAs to turn findings into clear, cost-effective recommendations for each client's technology roadmap.
* Tracks hardware and firmware end-of-life, vulnerabilities, and configuration drift across managed networks and plans remediation.
* Brings the customer's perspective to every recommendation: leads with business outcomes, not technology features.

Leadership
  
  

* Hires, onboards, coaches, and develops Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers, including technical mentoring and certification planning.
* Sets clear expectations, holds regular 1-on-1s, conducts performance reviews, and holds the team accountable using EOS tools (Rocks, Scorecards, Issues, To-Dos) in Strety.
* Manages team workload, project priorities, and resource availability, and plans and coordinates cross-functional or cross-company work.
* Owns network change management: reviews and approves changes, maintenance windows, and rollback plans.
* Manages the team's 24/7 on-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards.
* Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value.

Operations and Compliance
  
  

* Defines, tracks, and reports on network operations KPIs (see Success Measures below).
* Manages relationships with network vendors and carriers, including escalations, and supports procurement and licensing decisions.
* Ensures all compliance aspects of the position and team are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes, and regulations applicable to the position and company, including client HIPAA, PCI, and NIST requirements.
* Maintains sensitive and confidential information regarding company and customer information.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
Education and Work Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, or a related technical field
* 10+ years of experience with Service Provider, MSP, or enterprise networking or general telecommunications
* 3+ years in a Senior Network Engineer (or equivalent) role, serving as the top escalation and design resource for complex networks (required)
* 2+ years leading engineers as a manager, team lead, or technical lead, with direct responsibility for work assignment and mentoring
* MSP or multi-client environment experience strongly preferred

Specialized Knowledge and Skills
  
  

* Expert enterprise networking fundamentals, including complex switching and routing, high availability system design, advanced network security design, Internet services and protocols, and advanced network diagnostics.
* Demonstrated expert proficiency in at least three of the following, with advanced skills in the balance: core routing, core switching, network security, network diagnostics, and application load balancing.
* Top expert level analysis and design skills: gathering data on systems issues, defining alternative approaches, assessing business impact, and recommending, developing, and implementing cost-effective solutions.
* A track record of proactively finding and fixing problems in environments you support, with examples you can walk us through.
* Proven ability to lead, coach, and hold engineers accountable while staying hands-on.
* Excellent oral and written communication, including explaining technical risk and recommendations to non-technical customers and executives.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, incidents, and people concurrently.
* Advanced knowledge of current technologies, tools, applications, and vendors.

Certifications (preferred)
  
  

* CCNP Enterprise or Security, or equivalent experience; CCIE a strong plus
* Fortinet NSE, Meraki (CMNA/ECMS), or other vendor certifications
* ITIL Foundation or similar service management certification

Equipment and Applications
  
  

* Cisco Routers (ISR/ASR), Catalyst/Nexus Switches, Firepower and ASA Firewalls
* Cisco Viptela and Meraki SDWAN; Meraki Firewalls, Switches, and Wireless
* Fortinet Firewalls, FortiCloud, FortiClient
* Sophos Firewalls and Wireless
* SonicWALL Firewalls
* Unifi LAN Devices
* Ability to learn additional network platforms as needed

The Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead is the strategic technology architect responsible for the comprehensive digital lifecycle of our major infrastructure, utility corridors, bridges, and infrastructure master plans. Operating across the entire delivery continuum from conceptual design to asset handover this role unifies BIM, Geospatial Intelligence (GIS), Real-time Digital Twins, Legacy CAD standardizations, High-End 3D Visualizations, and AI-driven workflow automations.
  
  
You will not just manage models; you will design the overarching data infrastructure that connects engineering design to operational asset management, ensuring absolute data integrity, efficiency, and future-proof project delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities & Duties**

* Digital Strategy, Frameworks & BIM Governance
* Author, maintain, and enforce the overarching Digital Delivery Execution Plan (DDEP) and BIM Execution Plans (BEP) in strict compliance with ISO 19650 standards.
* Establish, structure, and administer the Common Data Environment (CDE) using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, setting up automated review workflows, ISO container compliance, and multi-firm security access permissions.
* Govern project coordinate systems, ensuring zero spatial or coordinate drift across linear highway alignments, utility networks, structural bridges, and global GIS maps.
* GIS & Digital Twin Integration
* Architect the bidirectional data pipelines connecting GIS platforms (Esri ArcGIS / QGIS) with horizontal engineering design software (Civil 3D / OpenRoads).
* Build the schema maps and asset metadata frameworks required to translate 3D BIM data into operational Digital Twin environments (e.g., Autodesk Tandem, Bentley iTwin, or custom web-based twin environments).
* Define asset tracking protocols to integrate future IoT sensor data metadata placeholders within the smart-city asset master list during the design phase.
* CAD Legacy & Hybrid Workflows
* Maintain strict quality control over traditional, two-dimensional deliverables by enforcing uniform CAD standards (layer structures, plot styles, sheet sets) alongside 3D environments.
* Manage hybrid workflows ensuring that legacy 2D drawings dynamically update from the core 3D federated model, minimizing manual drafting errors.
* 3D Visualization & Reality Capture
* Manage large-scale visual aggregation models within Autodesk InfraWorks, Twinmotion, or Unreal Engine to produce high-end, real-time interactive models for public consultation and executive stakeholder reviews.
* Oversite the integration of Reality Capture datasets (UAV Photogrammetry, LiDAR point clouds, mobile scanning) into active design environments for real-time site verification.
* AI Tools, Scripting & Automations
* Develop, scale, and deploy custom automations using Dynamo for Civil 3D/Revit, Python, or VBA to eliminate repetitive drafting tasks, automate grading calculations, and auto-populate asset metadata fields.
* Implement AI-driven design tools and generative design algorithms for optimizing massive earthworks volumes, alternative highway corridor alignments, and automated clash resolution pipelines.
* Utilize AI text and data analytics tools to run predictive automated audits on thousands of model parameters, catching quality drops instantly.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Information Management, Digital Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master's Degree would be advantageous
* Minimum 15 years of professional experience.
* Proven experience leading digital delivery on large-scale transport and infrastructure projects.
* Strong background supporting the design and delivery of:

+ Roads & Highways
+ Rail & Transit
+ Bridges and Structures
+ Utilities
+ Aviation
+ Smart Infrastructure Projects

* Demonstrated success in implementing BIM and digital transformation strategies within engineering consultancies.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary digital delivery teams.
* Experience working in the UAE and/or wider Middle East strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 standards.

**Technical Proficiencies:**

* BIM / Civil Design: Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D (corridors, pipes, gradings), InfraWorks, and Revit (structures/bridges).
* Geospatial (GIS): Expert capability in Esri ArcGIS (Pro / Online) and its native integrations with the Autodesk ecosystem.

Title: Major Incident Manager, Incident Management -TikTok USDS
Description:
**Responsibilities**
The USDS JV Incident Management Team (IMT) is a critical pillar within the US Tech and Product organization, dedicated to ensuring the resilience and reliability of TikTok’s U.S. Data Security infrastructure. As a security-first division, we focus on providing specialized oversight and protection for U.S. user data and the platforms that support them.
  
While global teams monitor overall service health, the IMT is uniquely positioned to manage the "blast radius" within the USDS environment. We act as the bridge between technical engineering teams (SRE, Infrastructure, Platform) and business stakeholders, ensuring that every major incident is handled with the precision and urgency required by our unique operating environment.
  
  
As a Major Incident Manager, you will be at the forefront of protecting the TikTok experience for millions of users. You will join a cohesive, proficient team committed to upholding the highest standards of professionalism and technical expertise, directly contributing to the safety and security of the U.S. digital ecosystem.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
- Incident Command: Lead the end-to-end response for high-severity incidents, driving rapid restoration of service while coordinating across cross-functional engineering teams.
  
- Stakeholder Communication: Craft and deliver clear, timely, and accurate communication updates to internal stakeholders, executive leadership, and customer-facing teams during critical events.
  
- Post-Incident Reviews: Facilitate blameless post-mortems, ensuring root causes are thoroughly identified, actionable remediation items are tracked, and lessons learned are shared globally.
  
- Dashboarding & Visibility: Create and maintain real-time operational dashboards that provide high visibility into system health, incident trends, and key reliability metrics (MTTD/MTTR).
  
- Continuous Improvement: Analyze incident data and operational metrics to identify systemic trends, driving initiatives to reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).
  
- Team Process Evolution: Manage and optimize the incident management rotation, refining playbooks, alerting thresholds, and escalation pathways for the SRE org.
  
- Alerting & Monitoring Improvements: Partner with SRE and development teams to continuously refine alert thresholds, reduce alert fatigue, and ensure high-severity pages are highly actionable.
  
- Automation Engineering: Design and build automated workflows to streamline incident response, such as automated stakeholder communications, auto-remediation scripts, and tool integrations.
  
- Oncall Support: The Incident Management team operates 24x5x365 with on-call rotation during weekends. This position is for the Sunday to Thursday shift, from 5 PM PT to 2 AM PT.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience) with 4+ years of experience in Incident Management, Production Support, or SRE/Operations within a large-scale SaaS or cloud environment.
  
- Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern infrastructure architectures (microservices, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines).
  
- Hands-on experience configuring and refining alerts and monitoring templates using industry-standard tools (e.g., Grafana, Splunk, Prometheus, New Relic).
  
- Ability to write scripts (e.g., Bash, Python) or use low-code integration tools to automate repetitive incident management tasks and notification pipelines.
  
- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a track record of translating deeply technical issues into clear business impact summaries for leadership.
  
- Strong working knowledge of ITIL incident management frameworks or modern DevOps/SRE incident response practices.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
- 5+ years of experience in Incident Management, Production Support, or SRE/Operations within a large-scale SaaS or cloud environment.
  
- Deep alignment with Google SRE principles, including Error Budgets, SLA/SLO/SLI management, and automation-first mindsets.
  
- Proven experience implementing ChatOps, auto-remediation workflows, or Event-Driven Ansible/Runbook automation to programmatically resolve common alerts.
  
- Advanced proficiency with modern incident orchestration platforms like PagerDuty, Opsgenie, JIRA Service Management, and Slack integrations.
  
- Experience using SQL, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools to build operational dashboards and report on organizational reliability metrics.
  
- Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL v4, AWS/GCP Certified Professional, or Certified Incident Commander.
  
- Experience coaching and training engineering teams on best practices for on-call hygiene and conducting constructive post-mortems.

Title: Oracle Service Delivery Manager
Description:
**About Centroid**
Centroid helps organizations modernize, operate, and support mission-critical business systems across Oracle and multi-cloud environments. We provide advisory, deployment, migration, integration, and managed services, with a focus on strong client service, dependable delivery, and career growth for our employees.
  
  
Travel: up to 10%
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Centroid is seeking a Service Delivery Manager (SDM) to lead assigned Cloud Managed Services accounts. This role is responsible for client satisfaction, service quality, account health, financial performance, and responsible growth. The SDM serves as the primary service management contact for clients and works closely with technical teams, leadership, and internal stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with scope, service commitments, and client expectations.
  
  
This is a client-facing delivery leadership role, not a hands-on technical administration role. The ideal candidate is organized, accountable, comfortable working through matrixed global teams, and able to manage priorities, risks, escalations, and follow-through in a fast-paced managed services environment.
  
  
What We’re Looking For
  
  
Success in this role requires more than experience. We are looking for candidates who can share real examples that demonstrate the following traits:
  
  

* Flexibility: Adapts quickly when priorities, client needs, or delivery constraints change.
* Process-driven and organized: Uses structure, follow-up routines, and clear communication to keep work moving.
* Intrinsically motivated: Takes initiative, follows through, and looks for ways to improve outcomes.
* Interested in learning and growing: Is coachable, curious, and open to learning Centroid’s way of working.
* Accountable: Owns commitments, raises risks early, and closes the loop with clients and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Client Leadership and Account Health
  
  

* Lead the overall health of assigned Cloud Managed Services accounts, including client satisfaction, retention, service quality, profitability, and responsible growth.
* Run the regular client and internal cadence, including monthly reviews, QBRs, risk reviews, decision tracking, and follow-up actions.
* Communicate performance, risks, recommendations, and improvement opportunities clearly to client and Centroid leadership.

Service Delivery and Governance
  
  

* Oversee service delivery across assigned accounts, technologies, and global teams while staying within SOWs, SLAs, procedures, and Centroid standards.
* Set up practical account governance, including meeting cadence, reporting, escalation paths, roles, responsibilities, and decision processes.
* Coordinate with technical, service desk, security, consulting, vendor, and leadership teams to keep work moving and handoffs clear.

Service Operations, Transitions, and Escalations
  
  

* Lead coordination and client communication during incidents, escalations, outages, maintenance windows, production changes, and other high-priority situations.
* Keep ownership clear, drive the communication rhythm, confirm recovery, and make sure RCA and corrective actions are completed.
* Support transitions into Cloud Managed Services by confirming scope, SLAs, resources, access, documentation, knowledge transfer, monitoring, ticket routing, and readiness.

Financial Management
  
  

* Manage account financial health, including budget, revenue, margin, utilization, forecasting, billing readiness, and financial risk.
* Watch demand and scope, identify out-of-scope work early, and support change orders, renewals, profitability improvements, and account planning.

Resource Leadership
  
  

* Lead onshore and offshore delivery teams supporting 24x7 operations while partnering with technical managers who own direct people management.
* Plan for capacity, identify coverage or skill gaps, coordinate assignments, improve handoffs, and coach teams on communication, documentation, escalation, and follow-through.

Security, Compliance, and Operational Risk
  
  

* Ensure assigned accounts follow Centroid’s security, privacy, access-management, audit, data-handling, and compliance requirements.
* Track evidence and follow-up for access approvals, onboarding, offboarding, controls, audit requests, security findings, patching needs, and other risks.

Reporting, Continuous Improvement, and Growth
  
  

* Provide clear reporting on SLAs, ticket trends, incidents, changes, availability, risks, projects, utilization, financials, and improvement actions.
* Use service data to spot recurring issues, process gaps, automation opportunities, and practical service improvements.
* Partner with Sales, Consulting, solution architects, and leadership on renewals, proposals, service expansion, and opportunities that create client value.

Additional Expectations
  
  
This is a remote position with limited travel. The SDM must be able to support client escalations, global team coordination, maintenance windows, and time-sensitive issues across time zones.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 10+ years of enterprise IT or technology services experience, including 3 to 5 years leading service delivery, client accounts, operations, projects, or matrixed teams.
* Experience managing multiple client accounts, SLA-based services, ITSM processes, governance, escalations, financials, utilization, scope, reporting, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and manage customer-facing service-delivery work.
* Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, conflict-resolution, organization, and prioritization skills.
* Ability to turn complex technical and operational information into clear business communication and action plans.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation or higher; PMP, Certified ScrumMaster, or another service or project management credential is helpful.
* Experience with a Managed Services Provider supporting 24x7 enterprise operations and Oracle application, database, integration, infrastructure, or engineered-system services.
* Working knowledge of OCI, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, hybrid environments, monitoring, patching, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, security, and identity and access management.
* Familiarity with HaloPSA, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, OpenAir, or similar platforms, plus experience with executive reviews, renewals, and service-growth opportunities.

Why Join Centroid
  
  
At Centroid, you will work with experienced teams, support meaningful client outcomes, and grow your career in a collaborative Cloud Managed Services environment. This role offers the opportunity to lead important client relationships, strengthen delivery practices, and make a visible impact across clients and internal teams.
