Title: Vice President, Infrastructure Services & Information Security
Description:
**Why We Are - Who We Are:** About FFF Enterprises
  
What We Do - https://www.fffenterprises.com/company/what-we-do.html
  
  
Position Summary
  
The Vice President, Infrastructure Services & Information Security leads the strategy, engineering, delivery, and operation of enterprise infrastructure services and information security across FFF Enterprises and its affiliated businesses. The position is accountable for the reliability, scalability, resilience, and security of technology platforms and services, including cloud and on-premises infrastructure, networks and communications, digital workplace and end-user services, distribution center technology, cybersecurity operations, and enterprise information protection.
  
The role establishes and executes integrated infrastructure and information security roadmaps, operating standards, service ownership models, security controls, and continuous improvement priorities aligned with enterprise technology strategy, business requirements, and regulatory obligations. Responsibilities include technology service delivery, operational resilience, information security governance, cyber risk management, vulnerability and third-party security oversight, incident preparedness and response, and secure adoption of emerging technologies.
  
Through leadership of multidisciplinary technical teams and collaboration with business and technology stakeholders, the Vice President strengthens service reliability, security effectiveness, operational performance, and organizational capabilities. The position provides informed recommendations to executive leadership regarding technology investments, material risks, operational priorities, and performance outcomes while supporting established escalation, risk acceptance, and independent assurance processes.
  
  
Essential Functions and Duties
  
Enterprise Technology & Security Strategy, Governance & Roadmaps:
  

* Lead integrated infrastructure services and information security planning, establishing multi-year roadmaps aligned with enterprise technology strategy, business growth, critical service needs, and applicable security requirements.
* Define organizational design, service ownership, roles, decision rights, and escalation practices across infrastructure engineering, operations, cybersecurity, security governance, and supporting vendors.
* Establish common planning and review cadences for service performance, security posture, investment decisions, remediation priorities, material incidents, and continuous improvement.
* Advise executive leadership on technology modernization, emerging threats, resilience, automation, AI, and the balance among service quality, security, risk, and cost.

**Cloud & Platform Engineering:**  

* Lead cloud and platform services across Azure, Google Cloud, Nutanix, operating systems, compute, storage, backup integration, identity integration, infrastructure as code, and cloud financial management.
* Establish platform engineering standards that strengthen availability, scalability, security hardening, configuration consistency, automation, and lifecycle management.
* Oversee platform modernization, technical debt reduction, capacity planning, patching coordination, and cloud consumption governance while maintaining secure architecture and change controls.
* Ensure infrastructure configurations, privileged access, logging, and recovery capabilities support applicable security and operational requirements.

**Network & Communications:**  

* Direct enterprise and distribution center network services, including WAN, wireless, cloud connectivity, internet redundancy, DNS/DHCP, VPN, voice, and collaboration systems.
* Establish network architecture, segmentation, resilience, capacity, monitoring, and lifecycle standards for reliable and secure connectivity.
* Define engineering ownership, operational escalation, and security responsibilities for network access, perimeter protections, and business-critical network services.

**Digital Workplace, End User Services & IT Service Management:**  

* Lead digital workplace and employee technology services for office, remote, hybrid, and distribution center personnel, including endpoint engineering, mobile management, Microsoft 365, collaboration, provisioning, patching, and device lifecycle.
* Oversee service desk operations and IT service management practices across incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, and service catalog management.
* Govern endpoint security integration, asset inventory, administrative controls, secure configuration, licensing, vendor services, and secure device disposition.
* Establish measurable employee service outcomes, service levels, ownership, and continuous improvement practices across supported environments.

Site Reliability, Operational Resilience & Business Continuity:
  

* Lead monitoring and observability, service reliability engineering, incident management, root-cause analysis, backup validation, capacity management, disaster recovery, and operational readiness for critical business services.
* Establish recovery objectives, resilient designs, redundancy requirements, continuity exercises, and recovery testing aligned with critical business processes and security scenarios.
* Direct coordinated operational response to major technology availability incidents, including service restoration, escalation, stakeholder communications, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
* Coordinate infrastructure recovery and business continuity capabilities with information security incident response planning, including ransomware resilience and recovery testing.

**Warehouse & Distribution Center Technology Enablement:**  

* Oversee distribution center technology enablement, including warehouse wireless services, RF devices, scanners, printers, shipping workstations, local infrastructure, and site support.
* Coordinate technology dependencies for warehouse control systems, automation and conveyor interfaces, PLC connectivity, site upgrades, and peak-period readiness with Operations and vendors.
* Establish support boundaries, cybersecurity coordination, availability expectations, and escalation pathways for operational technology and warehouse infrastructure.
* Ensure appropriate business-critical recovery, segmentation, resilience, monitoring, and security controls for distribution center technology.

**Information Security Program, Architecture & Operations:**  

* Direct the enterprise information security program across FFF and applicable affiliated businesses, safeguarding confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information and technology assets.
* Develop and maintain security strategy, policies, technical standards, control baselines, information classification, and security architecture aligned to enterprise operating requirements.
* Oversee security monitoring, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, endpoint and network protection, identity and privileged access security, security configuration, and remediation governance.
* Establish enterprise processes for identifying and evaluating cyber threats, reviewing emerging technologies, and embedding security into technology architecture, product development, procurement, and change management.
* Guide security capabilities and qualified internal or external specialists to provide risk-informed protection of platforms, applications, networks, sensitive information, and technology services.
* Develop security awareness and role-based training programs, promoting informed, accountable security behaviors among employees, contractors, and approved users.

**Cyber Risk, Information Protection & Third-Party Assurance:**  

* Establish and maintain the enterprise information security risk assessment process, including threat evaluation, control assessment, risk treatment tracking, and documentation of material exposures.
* Oversee cybersecurity reviews of technology suppliers and material third parties, including contractual security requirements, assessment findings, remediation commitments, and ongoing risk monitoring.
* Coordinate with business owners, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Audit on information ownership, data classification, secure handling, retention, and protection requirements.
* Report material cybersecurity risks, control deficiencies, third-party exposures, exceptions, and remediation status to designated leadership and risk governance stakeholders.
* Establish clear processes for identifying, assessing, documenting, escalating, and monitoring information security risks, ensuring material risk acceptance and independent assurance activities remain subject to established enterprise governance and designated approval authority.

**Security Policy, Regulatory Compliance & Audit:**  

* Lead development, maintenance, implementation, and communication of practical enterprise information security policies, standards, and procedures.
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Internal Audit to evaluate applicable obligations and control expectations, including HIPAA, PCI DSS, CCPA/CPRA, and other relevant requirements as determined by the business.
* Coordinate security control assessments, audit evidence, remediation plans, and management responses in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and Internal Audit, while respecting their independent responsibilities.
* Use risk-based frameworks such as NIST and ISO 27001, where appropriate, to inform security maturity assessments, control effectiveness measures, and improvement roadmaps.
* Track security policy exceptions, audit findings, control deficiencies, and overdue remediation, and communicate material developments through established governance channels.

**Cybersecurity Incident Response & Crisis Coordination:**  

* Direct and coordinate preparedness, detection, containment, investigation, recovery, and lessons learned during material information security incidents.
* Convene and coordinate designated security incident response resources and business stakeholders, with clear authority, severity classifications, playbooks, escalation triggers, and communication processes.
* Coordinate with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, executive leadership, and external specialists on notification assessments, law enforcement engagement, evidence preservation, and crisis communications, as applicable.
* Oversee incident response exercises, technical readiness, external incident response retainers, and improvement activities following security events.
* Escalate material cybersecurity incidents promptly and coordinate technical recovery with operational continuity and established legal and crisis management processes.

**Infrastructure Architecture, Automation & Responsible AI:**  

* Establish infrastructure architecture standards, reference designs, engineering practices, lifecycle planning, interoperability, and secure target-state direction.
* Advance infrastructure automation, orchestration, reusable platforms, self-service capabilities, and responsible AI-assisted operational tools with appropriate controls and human oversight.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and AI governance stakeholders to assess information protection, system access, reliability, and operational risks before new technology adoption.
* Prioritize emerging technology investments based on measurable service improvement, security outcomes, business value, operational complexity, and cost.

**Financial, Vendor & Performance Management:**  

* Own approved infrastructure and information security operating budgets, financial plans, contracts, vendor performance, resource allocations, and delivery commitments within established financial authority.
* Develop business cases and investment recommendations addressing resilience, modernization, technical debt, security maturity, regulatory exposure, and risk reduction.
* Establish integrated service and security measures for reliability, incident response, recovery, vulnerability remediation, control effectiveness, audit progress, service quality, customer experience, and cost.
* Provide regular reporting to executive leadership on service performance, material risk, financial results, investment progress, incident trends, vendor outcomes, and roadmap commitments.
* Maintain effective vendor governance for technical service levels, security obligations, incident response support, contractual performance, and required corrective actions.

**Organization, Workforce & Talent Leadership:**  

* Build and develop a high-performing combined Infrastructure Services and Information Security organization with clear functional leadership, accountability, technical expertise, and appropriate segregation of duties.
* Lead multi-year workforce and capability planning, succession, critical-role coverage, insourcing and outsourcing decisions, vendor augmentation, and targeted capability development.
* Develop leaders, managers, engineers, and security practitioners through coaching, performance management, cross-training, knowledge transfer, and career development.
* Promote a culture of engineering excellence, service ownership, proactive risk identification, ethical decision-making, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

Education, Knowledge, Skills, and Experience
  
  
**Required Education:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.

**Preferred Education:**  

* Advanced degree in technology leadership, cybersecurity, business administration, or related discipline.

**Required Knowledge:**

Title: Global Security Operations Centre Manager
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Manager in Doha, Qatar.**

The GSOC Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operations of the GSOC, including but not limited to provision of guidance and supervision to other GSOC members such as GSOC Supervisor and GSOC Operator, in line with the direction set by QatarEnergy and in accordance with global standards, processes and industry best practices.

The GSOC Manager will work closely with the GSOC Supervisor and the GSOC Operator, to ensure operational planning and request management guidance are done in lockstep with ongoing and continuous intelligence assessments.

The GSOC Manager will act as enabler in the process of decision-making, in both business-as-usual and crisis scenarios, and provide required insights to support the analytical position and outlook of QatarEnergy.

The GSOC Manager will closely collaborate with the GSOC team (Supervisor and Operator) in one hand, and other departments of QatarEnergy on another, ensuring the relevant throughputs of GSOC contain an appropriate security risk assessment as part of any response and plan of action. In principle, the GSOC Manager will provide Quality Assurance check on the output of GSOC.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

  

* Oversee GSOC operational preparedness, ensuring timely security advice and clear risk assessments are provided to QatarEnergy stakeholders and business travellers.
* Provide strategic direction and oversight of GSOC request management, operational planning and service provider networks, ensuring alignment with QatarEnergy’s security outlook.
* Oversee the quality and continuous improvement of GSOC deliverables, ensuring alignment with security risk management best practices and operational requirements.
* Develop GSOC team capabilities through guidance, coaching and training in global threat monitoring, travel risk management, and crisis and emergency management.
* Collaborate with QatarEnergy stakeholders and internal departments to ensure effective query management, operational coordination and security planning.
* Maintain and enhance travel risk management resources, including hotel and security provider information, ensuring they reflect the current security environment.
* Contribute to security capability enhancement projects, including risk management training and Concept of Operations development.
* Conduct regional travel, as required, to assess security environments, evaluate local provider capabilities and strengthen security intelligence and assistance networks.
* Participate in regional security calls and support security escalations, including Crisis Updates, Crisis Management Team (CMT) briefings, and the development and execution of Plans of Action (POAs).
* Provide guidance and oversight for Executive Protection (EP) requests, leveraging vetted providers and regional expertise.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

  

* Provide strategic oversight of global threat monitoring activities and intelligence outputs, ensuring alignment with global standards and best practices.
* Guide analytical direction, validate threat assessments and integrate intelligence insights into organisational risk management and decision-making.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Oversee the delivery of travel security risk management services, ensuring alignment with client expectations and continuous intelligence assessments.
* Ensure quality assurance of travel-related security outputs, recommendations and operational planning.
* Engage with stakeholders to support the effective implementation of travel security strategies.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management**

  

* Lead GSOC operations during crises and major incidents, providing strategic direction and enabling informed decision-making.
* Oversee crisis response activities and ensure effective coordination between GSOC, internal departments and external partners.
* Approve escalation decisions and ensure appropriate communication with senior leadership.
* Maintain quality assurance across incident reporting, response actions and crisis management outputs.
* Support continuous capability development through training, mentoring and improvement initiatives.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**
-------------------------------

* Extremely strong knowledge of the security risk management best practices and principals across a diversity of risk environments.
* Experience in planning and managing security assistance operations.
* Experience in conducting profile specific security risk assessments.
* Strong knowledge of the political and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including ability to explain complex situations and advice to non-expert audiences in English.
* Ability to critically analyse multiple streams of security, logistics and threat-based information under time pressure and produce plans of action.
* Ability to identify key streams of effort and direct colleagues accordingly.
* On the ground experience in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operation.
* Strong IT skills including Microsoft Office Suite and other applications.

**Required Work Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically, at least 8+ years’ experience in security assistance delivery and planning including deployed experience in hostile and/or challenging environments in military, NGO, government or private sector roles ideally in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Experience in planning and conducting security assistance operations.
* Experience in writing to senior management and decision-makers.
* Experience in successfully working cross culturally.

### 

### **Preferred Experience**

* Crisis management and Business Continuity Management experience.
* Security consulting and training delivery experience.
* Public speaking, client-facing presentation and/or media experience.
* Experience in business development and quality management

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Educated to a degree level (or relevant professional training & experience) in a field related to security studies, war studies, international politics, international relations or similar.
* Accreditation by regionally recognised security or risk management body.

**Required Languages**
----------------------

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Other language (Arabic, French, etc.) proficiency desirable.

Title: Digital Operations, Manager
Description:
At PwC, our people in operations consulting specialise in providing consulting services on optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. These individuals analyse client needs, develop operational strategies, and offer guidance and support to help clients streamline processes, improve productivity, and drive business performance. As an operations consulting generalist at PwC, you will possess a broad understanding of various aspects of operations consulting. You will provide comprehensive guidance and support to clients in optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. Working in this area, you will analyse client needs, develop operational solutions, and offer recommendations tailored to specific business requirements.

**The Opportunity:**

As a Digital Operations, Consulting Manager, you will lead small delivery teams and work directly with client stakeholders to translate complex operational, business, and technology questions into practical solutions leaders can trust and act on. The role emphasizes clarity, explainability, decision impact, and requires comfort working across operations, analytics, technology, and solution delivery. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:

**Core Operations**

* Lead assessments of core operations across the operations, including production and plant operations, integrated planning and scheduling, field and site operations, maintenance and asset management, materials and inventory, and health, safety, and environment (HSE).
* Define operational performance frameworks and KPIs (e.g., throughput, overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), asset availability, yield, unit cost, schedule adherence, safety performance) and use them to prioritize improvement opportunities and track value delivered.
* Shape operations strategies and improvement roadmaps, such as integrated and remote operations, production optimization, asset performance management, and workforce and field productivity.
* Design future-state operating models, processes, and workflows that connect field, plant, and control room operations with enterprise systems and decision-making.
* Act as the bridge between operations leaders (e.g., site, plant, field, and maintenance) and technology teams, making sure solutions reflect frontline realities and safety, regulatory, environmental, and operational risk requirements

**Decision Framing**

* Structure complex operational, business process, and technology challenges as decision problems under uncertainty.
* Lead assessments of how client operations and technology work today, and how mature they are, to identify and prioritize opportunities for digitization, automation, and emerging technology adoption, Lead assessments of how client operations and technology work today, and how mature they are, to identify and prioritize opportunities for digitization, automation, and emerging technology adoption.
* Apply appropriate analytical rigor based on decision criticality, data quality, and time constraints.

**Applied Modelling**

* Apply quantitative techniques including: operational process and performance analysis; asset reliability, availability, and maintenance strategy analysis; capacity, throughput, and flow analysis; scenario and probabilistic analysis using simulation; and assessment of technology options and their operational impact.
* Lead the evaluation, prototyping, and piloting of technologies (e.g., AI/machine learning, generative AI, intelligent automation, advanced analytics, digital twins, IoT) in operational settings, and plan how successful pilots are scaled up and implemented.
* Translate analytical outputs into operations and technology recommendations, roadmaps, and decision-ready insights.

* Work with technical teams to shape data flows, reporting logics, solution requirements, and system integration points.
* Oversee technology implementation activities, including solution design, platform and vendor evaluation, testing, change management, and user adoption.
* Review and guide analytics code and pipelines; not required to be the primary developer.

**Team & Client Leadership**

* Lead and coach small teams, oversee work quality, and resolve delivery issues.
* Engage directly with client stakeholders to align insights and solution design to decision needs and communicate results clearly.
* Work effectively across both business and technical stakeholder groups.

**What you’ll Bring:**

Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:

* Degree in industrial/systems engineering, computer science, business analytics, or a closely related quantitative field.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant field
* Must have prior consulting experience in related field
* Experience applying quantitative analysis and/or digital solutioning approaches to core operations (e.g., operations and maintenance, asset management), supply chain, or complex planning problems in defense, utilities, energy, mining, manufacturing, or other asset‑intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of core operations and maintenance processes, with the ability to advise clients on how technology can improve them.
* Demonstrated ability to bridge operational context and analytics.
* Prior experience managing small teams and contributing to client‑facing engagements.
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms, system integration concepts, data architecture, cloud, AI, automation and digital workflow enablement is an asset.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas for non‑technical audiences.

Title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure | USA | Remote
Description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

*This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US or Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).*

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

### **About our platform**

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

### **About the Infrastructure group**

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

### **How we work**

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.
* Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.
* Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.
* Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.
* Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.
* Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.
* Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.
* Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**
------------------------------

* Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage
* Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
* Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.
* A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.
* The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.
* Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.
* You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.
* Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.

**Bonus Points For**
--------------------

* Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability
* Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
* Building self-service infrastructure for application teams
* Running observability for a production platform at scale
* Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure
* You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"

Title: Senior Project Manager - Service Delivery
Description:
****Who We Are****
PLATO is Canada’s largest Indigenous-owned software testing and technology services company. For nearly 30 years, our expert teams have helped our clients deliver reliable products that users enjoy interacting with.
  
  
Our 100% Canada‑based team brings deep experience in QA, software testing, and IT services, along with a shared commitment to collaboration, mentorship, and continuous improvement. We’re a team that shows up for each other, whether that’s tackling complex client challenges or helping colleagues grow through coaching and knowledge‑sharing.
  
  
As Canada’s largest Indigenous‑owned software testing company, we’re proud of our roots and our mission to build a stronger, more inclusive technology workforce. At the same time, we warmly welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences who are passionate about quality, teamwork, and making an impact.
  
  
****Work With Us****
At PLATO, we believe that great work happens when people feel supported, connected, and challenged in the right ways. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where experienced professionals share knowledge, mentor others, and contribute to solving complex, real‑world client projects.
  
  
We are committed to inclusive hiring practices and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including women, persons with disabilities, visible minorities, and Indigenous peoples. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, we’re here to support you.
  
  
PLATO respectfully acknowledges that we operate on treaty territories, unceded First Nations and Inuit territories, and within Métis homelands. We honour the long history of these lands and actively work toward reconciliation between Indigenous and non‑Indigenous peoples on Turtle Island.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Lead end-to-end service delivery for a major strategic client, ensuring consistent delivery quality, operational excellence, stakeholder satisfaction, and achievement of contractual and business outcomes. Serve as the primary delivery interface between the client, internal teams, leadership, and third-party vendors, with accountability for governance, processes, risks, escalations, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Over 10 years experience delivering complex technology projects in large scale environments
* Project Management education or certification an asset

**Key Responsibilities**
**End-to-End Client Delivery**

* Own end-to-end delivery across the client engagement, from planning and mobilization through execution, operational support, and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate multiple workstreams and delivery teams while maintaining an integrated view of priorities, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.
* Establish a predictable delivery operating rhythm through governance meetings, dashboards, reviews, and executive reporting.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary senior delivery contact for the client.
* Build strong relationships with client executives, business stakeholders, technology teams, and internal leadership.
* Lead service reviews, governance meetings, and executive-level delivery discussions.
* Manage expectations proactively and communicate delivery risks, decisions, dependencies, and corrective actions clearly.

**Process & Service Management**

* Establish, maintain, and continuously improve delivery and operational processes.
* Define governance mechanisms, RACI, escalation paths, operating procedures, and service-management practices.

**Escalation & Risk Management**

* Own critical client and operational escalations through resolution.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams during high-priority incidents and delivery issues.
* Maintain visibility of risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Provide timely executive communication during critical situations.
* Ensure lessons learned from major incidents are converted into measurable process improvements.

**Vendor & Partner Management**

* Manage third-party vendors, subcontractors, and technology partners supporting the engagement.
* Coordinate dependencies between internal teams, client teams, and external vendors.
* Address vendor performance issues and drive corrective action when required.
* Support commercial discussions, contract reviews, renewals, and changes in service scope.

**Financial & Resource Management**

* Manage resource planning, capacity, utilization, and delivery forecasts.
* Monitor engagement financials, including revenue, cost, margin, and delivery efficiency.
* Identify staffing needs and balance capacity against changing client demand.
* Partner with leadership on growth opportunities and expansion of services within the account.

**Leadership**

* Provide leadership and direction to multidisciplinary delivery teams.
* Create accountability for delivery outcomes while enabling teams to resolve issues quickly.
* Mentor delivery managers and team leads.
* Promote a culture of client focus, transparency, collaboration, continuous improvement, and ownership.

Title: Manager, Post Incident Reviews and Incident Management
Description:

* Strong writing ability and experience creating reports from incident data and multiple sources of information
* Experience leading investigations and root cause analyses involving complex operational or technology incidents.

Title: NOC Manager
Description:
**Who We Are:**

At
**Bandwidth**
, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach.  The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day.

Because we own the network we build on,
*the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful.*
And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible.

We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next?
**#JoinTheBand**

**What We Are Looking For:**

As a
**NOC Manager,**
you will be an instrumental part of Bandwidth.com’s Network Operations Center (NOC). The ideal candidate will ensure that the NOC drives issues to resolution, and the team meets all of it’s KPI’s. This is a role that requires individuals to lead a team to successfully meets its objectives, all while working in a complex troubleshooting environment.

**What You'll Do:**

* Supervise a 24x7x365 NOC shift and personnel that monitors, troubleshoots and repairs service-impacting network issues.
* Manage a team of technicians, providing guidance and mentorship, while ensuring that team obligations are met.
* Oversee day-to-day NOC operations, escalations, ticketing and communications.
* Ensure that issues impacting company production infrastructure, systems, and applications are being driven to resolution.
* Identify areas for process and efficiency improvement within the team.
* Create documentation around new workflows, and ensure that training is provided for internal team members.
* Serve as part of the escalation path for internal and external network issues.
* Gather reporting on network Service Level Agreements (SLA’s) and team Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s), and ensure that these metrics are being met.
* Review team member tickets for quality, ensuring that due diligence is being performed, and that standard operating procedures are being followed.
* Oversee network repair and after-hours maintenance activity (switch, transport and trunks).
* Will be part of a rotating management on-call schedule.
* While on-call, subject to receiving call outs 24 hours, 7 days a week.
* Participate in strategic planning sessions related to infrastructure, product launches, and network readiness.
* Represent the NOC in executive updates, audits, or customer reviews.
* Support special projects, organizational change initiatives, or process redesigns as needed.

**What You Need:**

* Education:
  + Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience:
  + 6+ years of experience in network or service operations, with at least 3 years in a leadership or management role.
  + Demonstrated success managing multi-shift or multi-site operational teams in a 24x7 environment.
* Knowledge:
  + Strong understanding of ITIL or equivalent service management frameworks.
  + Deep familiarity with incident, change, and problem management processes.
  + Working knowledge of network monitoring, infrastructure operations, and service delivery models.
* Skills:
  + Proven ability to lead and develop high-performing teams and managers.
  + Excellent analytical, communication, and decision-making skills.
  + Strong organizational and planning abilities, with a focus on metrics and performance outcomes.
  + Capable of managing complex, cross-functional initiatives with minimal oversight.

**Bonus Points:**

* Education:
  + Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience:
  + Experience leading NOC modernization or automation initiatives.
  + Background in telecommunications, SaaS, or large-scale network service environments.
* Knowledge:
  + Familiarity with observability platforms, cloud networking, and DevOps practices.
  + Advanced understanding of workforce optimization and capacity planning methodologies.
* Skills:
  + Strategic thinking and change management.
  + Skilled in influencing without authority across diverse technical and business teams.
  + Competence in data storytelling and executive-level reporting.

**The Whole Person Promise:**

At Bandwidth, we’re pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our “Whole Person Promise.” We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

* 100% company-paid Medical, Vision, & Dental coverage for you and your family with low deductibles and low out-of-pocket expenses.
* All new hires receive four weeks of PTO.
* PTO Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you’re embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your PTO – not even with email.
* Additional PTO can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges.
* “Mahalo moments” program grants additional time off for life’s most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild.
* 90-Minute Workout Lunches and unlimited meetings with our very own nutritionist.

Are you excited about the position and its responsibilities, but not sure if you’re 100% qualified? Do you feel you can work to help us crush the mission? If you answered ‘yes’ to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won’t want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND.

Title: INNOVATION AND TECHNOLOGY NETWORK MANAGER - (NON-CLASSIFIED) *
Description:
The Position
  
  
The City of Riverside, Innovation and Technology Department (IT) is accepting applications for the position of
**INNOVATION AND TECHNOLOGY NETWORK MANAGER to**
fill one (1) vacancy in the
**Network Division**
**.**
The eligibility list established may be used to fill the current and/or upcoming vacancies within this classification for up to six 6 months.
  
  
The Network Manager position will lead and perform advanced-level network administration and operational oversight as part of the City's Network Team, supporting the daily availability, performance, and security of enterprise-wide communications infrastructure that includes WAN/LAN, data center, wireless, voice, and public safety networks. This role is responsible for coordinating day-to-day network operations such as monitoring and responding to alerts, troubleshooting and resolving escalated incidents, managing configurations and change activities, overseeing backups and redundancy, maintaining network documentation and standards, and coordinating vendor support and carrier services. In addition, the Network Manager will guide and mentor technical staff, collaborate closely with other IT teams and City departments, and ensure networks supporting cameras, radio systems, and mission-critical applications remain highly available, secure, and compliant, while also contributing to longer-term planning, upgrades, and modernization initiatives to meet the evolving needs of City services and the community
  
  
Under general supervision, the Innovation and Technology Network Manager is to plan, organize and direct information technology functions related to Networking, Data Center Operation, and Enterprise Applications or Enterprise Project Management Applications and to perform related work as required.
  
  

* Actual job classification is Innovation and Technology Officer II (Non-Classified). Positions designated as non-classified are exempt from the classified service. The incumbent will be appointed "at-will" and serve at the pleasure of the City Manager.

**For positions indicating a salary range from 1N – 2X, the top 15% of the pay range cannot be offered upon hire or upon an employee promotion.**
Work Performed
  
  
Typical duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:
  
  

* Develop and implement project plans to accomplish work group objectives and assign work and monitor performance. Take action in the full range of formal personnel activities, and provide contract oversight in conjunction within the Innovation and Technology Department.
* Provide subject matter expertise in highly complex mission critical enterprise-wide systems which require expertise in multiple industry areas.
* Prepare, negotiate and present budget and other funding proposals; monitor expenditures and operate within budget allocation.
* Develop strategic plans and implement operational plans to provide information technology infrastructure to support the City's/Department's business goals; and oversee one or more of the following technical areas: Enterprise Applications or Enterprise Project Manager Applications, Networking, and Data Center Operations.

When assigned to Enterprise Applications or Enterprise Project Management Applications:
  
  

* Manage all activities related to the design, development and implementation of information systems and software applications.
* Oversee maintenance, support and upgrade of existing systems and applications.
* Confirm software integration into existing systems, meets functional requirements, systems compliance and interface specifications.
* Design, develop, and install enhancements and upgrades to systems and application software.
* Compile and maintain an inventory of all software and system assets, and corresponding contracts and agreements.
* Develop training materials for end users and conduct training as necessary.

**When Assigned To Networking**

* Plan, coordinate and supervise activities of a complex communications infrastructure, including radio, microwave and wireless communications, voice services, including WAN/LAN technology, switches, routers and fiber optics, and supporting management applications.
* Plan, coordinate and supervise activities of over 1,000 security cameras.
* Establish schedules and internal controls to meet deadlines.
* Manage city-owned or leased equipment and line and service installation and expansion.
* Identify areas for improvement and implement and maintain new or improved services to meet changing technical and customer requirements.
* Review, evaluate and recommend telecommunications hardware and software packages.

**When Assigned To Data Center Operations**

* Plan, coordinate and supervise the enterprise computing services including messaging and collaboration software including, email, unified communications, servers, desktop and server virtualization technologies, enterprise desktop management tools, data storage and backup infrastructure, Active Directory, VPN and system monitoring tools.
* Design and implement short and long-term strategic plans to ensure system capacity meets existing and future requirements.
* Ensure a high level of application, server and storage, and enterprise system availability.
* Develop, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures, and associated training plans for related infrastructure operations.
* Plan the acquisition and installation of hardware equipment, applicable enterprise system software and maintenance agreements.
* Maintain data center facilities.
* Assist with the planning and deployment of server, storage infrastructure and enterprise system security measures.
* Develop, implement and maintain an efficient, well documented disaster recovery plan.

**Qualifications**
**OPTION I:**

* Education: A Master's degree in computer science, information systems or public/business administration.
* Experience: Three years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing, and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Option Ii**

* Education: Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in computer science, information systems, electronics engineering, voice/data communications, public/business administration or a related field.
* Experience: Four years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Option Iii**

* Education: Associate of Arts degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in computer science, information systems, electronics engineering voice/data communications, public/business administration or related field.
* Experience: Six years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Option Iv**

* Education: Equivalent of the completion of the twelfth grade.
* Experience: Eight years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Necessary Special Qualifications**

* When assigned to the Police Department, must be able to successfully pass an extensive police background.

**Network Manager Highly Desirables**

* Enterprise Network Architecture and Engineering: Advanced experience designing, implementing, and managing large-scale WAN/LAN environments, including routing and switching, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, fiber-optic infrastructure, wireless networking, network segmentation, SD-WAN, and enterprise connectivity.
* Network Leadership and Staff Development: Proven success managing technical teams, establishing performance expectations, delegating responsibilities, mentoring employees, addressing performance deficiencies, and maintaining accountability for operational and project outcomes.
* Project Management and Strategic Planning: Demonstrated ability to independently plan, budget, coordinate, and deliver complex infrastructure projects while managing competing priorities, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and long-term technology modernization strategies.
* Operational Excellence and Infrastructure Lifecycle Management: Extensive experience establishing and enforcing network operational standards, preventive maintenance programs, patch management, change control procedures, hardware lifecycle planning, asset management, and comprehensive technical documentation.
* Network Security, Resiliency, and Business Continuity: Strong background implementing enterprise security controls, firewalls, Zero Trust principles, secure connectivity, redundancy, disaster recovery, and high-availability solutions supporting mission-critical services.
* Financial, Procurement, and Vendor Management: Proven experience developing and managing technology budgets, evaluating procurement requirements, administering vendor contracts, monitoring service-level agreements, validating deliverables, and maintaining financial accountability.
* Communication, Collaboration, and Organizational Accountability: Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated success proactively communicating project status, identifying and escalating risks, maintaining follow-through, coordinating across departments, and presenting technical information to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Enterprise Monitoring, Troubleshooting, and Continuous Improvement: Advanced experience managing enterprise network monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, performance optimization, capacity planning, network automation, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Public Safety and Mission-Critical Infrastructure: Experience managing complex networking environments supporting public safety communications, radio and microwave systems, surveillance cameras, telecommunications, fiber infrastructure, and other essential 24/7 government or enterprise services.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) serves customers and developers who rely on storage, compute, and our other service capabilities. Our customers trust us to handle their data with air-tight security measures, which is something that we guarantee.  
  
AWS is growing rapidly, and we are looking for a Data Center Security Manager to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Data Center Security Manager (individual contributor) you will be tasked with driving operational security excellence in several separate facilities located within a short driving distance. Your constant vigilance will discover physical security gaps and shortcomings, which you will drive to fix immediately. You will interface and direct vendors involved in new security construction, repairs, daily security operations and patrols, and planning. You will extract metrics and observe improvements by looking at hard data. You will make suggestions on improving electronic surveillance and access controls. You will direct efforts to educate data center occupants on false alarm reductions. You will write and implement security process and procedures. Your position will require you to write reports, create presentations and communicate with management on the status of physical security operations.  
  
About the team  
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Bring your expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of a growing resiliency testing organization, you will play a key role in helping businesses strengthen preparedness, validate resiliency capabilities, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement through meaningful testing and simulation activities.

As an Associate Incident Manager in Business Resiliency, you will coordinate response activities for major incidents and disruptions affecting customers, employees, and lines of business. * Experience working within an incident management framework under time pressure, including threat assessment support, stakeholder communications, and coordinated response.
* Knowledge of contact center operations, customer behavior, and the technology ecosystem that supports technical and non-technical incident response.
* Strong documentation, action tracking, operational follow-through, judgment, and escalation skills.
* Project management and cross-functional coordination skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Process improvement experience, including workflow mapping, root cause analysis, change implementation, and outcome measurement.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including preparation of concise senior-leader updates and facilitation across diverse stakeholders.

* Business resiliency or business continuity experience in a matrixed corporate environment, preferably within financial services.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or ITIL certification or training.
* Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt, Green Belt, or higher, or demonstrated delivery of measurable operational improvements.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with experience defining dashboard requirements and operational metrics.
* Experience using data, AI, or automation to improve the speed, accuracy, or consistency of operational processes.

Title: Incident Operations Manager
Description:
**About This Role**
At Chime, we help our members achieve financial peace of mind. To do this we need features that are highly available and human & technical systems that are resilient. That’s where you come in. You will be a member of our Incident Response team to help Chime improve our readiness, response and drive organizational change from incidents.
  
  
As an Incident Operations Manager on Chime's Incident Operations team (Platform Engineering), you'll manage incidents end to end: from declaration and coordination, through member communication and member remediation, to review and follow-through. You'll work across Engineering, Product, Member Experience (MX), Core Experience, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, and lead through influence rather than authority. You'll bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset and keep the member at the center of every decision. Alongside on-call work, you'll own defined improvement workstreams that make our response better every quarter.
  
  
**In This Role, You Can Expect To**

* Coordinate incidents end to end. Serve on the incident on-call rotation, including some after-hours coverage on weekends, nights, and holidays. Independently run incidents from declaration to resolution: setting severity, paging the right responders, running the bridge, confirming member impact, and driving mitigation decisions.
* Help drive communication during incidents. Draft clear, accurate member messages across in-app, push, inbox, email, and support channels; move them through Compliance and Legal approval within severity-based timelines; and keep Support and MX teams equipped with talking points.
* Drive member remediation to closure. Run the Remediating phase: define workstreams, DRIs, and exit criteria; partner with Data to size the impacted population; coordinate credits and bulk adjustments with Finance, Compliance, and Core Experience
* Keep stakeholders informed. Deliver timely status reports and sitreps for leadership, and supply impact summaries and timelines that Compliance and Legal use for bank partner and regulatory notifications.

Title: Major Incident IT Manager, Temporary
Description:
**WHY UT SOUTHWESTERN?**
  
With over 75 years of excellence in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas, UT Southwestern is committed to excellence, innovation, teamwork, and compassion. As a world-renowned medical and research center, we strive to provide the best possible care, resources, and benefits for our valued employees. Ranked as the No. 1 hospital in Dallas-Fort Worth according to *U.S. News & World Report*, we invest in you with opportunities for career growth and development to align with your future goals. Our highly competitive benefits package offers healthcare, PTO and paid holidays, on-site childcare, wage, merit increases and so much more. We invite you to be a part of the UT Southwestern team where you’ll discover a culture of teamwork, professionalism, and a rewarding career!

**JOB SUMMARY**
  
**This is a 6-month to 1-year temporary position with an opportunity to move to a permanent role depending on performance.**
  
The Major Incident Manager coordinates and manages responses to major IT incidents to minimize business disruption and restore services as quickly as possible. This role serves as the central coordination point throughout the major incident lifecycle, facilitating cross-functional collaboration, managing escalations, coordinating technical teams, and ensuring timely stakeholder communications. Working within established ITIL practices, the position partners with the Incident Management Process Owner, ITSM team, technical resolver groups, Service Desk, Communications Managers, Problem Management, and IT and Hospital leadership. Responsibilities also include supporting Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs), collaborating on Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and tracking follow-up actions. This is a hands-on operational role requiring occasional overnight, weekend, and holiday availability to support major incident response.

**BENEFITS**
  
UT Southwestern is proud to offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees. Our benefits are designed to support your overall wellbeing, and include:

* PPO medical plan, available day one at no cost for full-time employee-only coverage
* 100% coverage for preventive healthcare-no copay
* Paid Time Off, available day one
* Retirement Programs through the Teacher Retirement System of Texas (TRS)
* Paid Parental Leave Benefit
* Wellness programs
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) Qualified Employer
  

**Required Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Required Experience**

* **Five or more years of experience in IT Service Management, Incident Management, IT Operations, or a related IT service delivery function.**
* **A minimum of 5 year’s experience as a Major Incident Manager with experience coordinating and leading high-impact incidents, escalations, or cross-functional IT operational activities.**
* Working knowledge of Incident Management and Major Incident Management practices.
* Experience using ServiceNow ITSM, including Incident Management and related workflows.
* Strong understanding of incident prioritization, impact assessment, escalation procedures, and service restoration activities.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple technical teams and stakeholders during time-sensitive situations.
Experience with Post-Incident Reviews, Problem Management, and Root Cause Analysis is preferred.  

**Preffered Experience**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information to non-technical audiences and leadership.
* Strong facilitation, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to remain composed, exercise sound judgment, and manage competing priorities in high-pressure situations.
* Demonstrated accountability, attention to detail, and ability to maintain accurate incident documentation and timelines.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across organizational boundaries.
ITIL 4 Foundation certification preferred; ITIL v5 certification or relevant ITSM training is a plus.  

**Work Schedule & Availability**
  
This is a temporary to permanent, full-time position. While the position will generally operate during standard business hours, overnight, weekend, and holiday work will be required periodically to support major incident response, service restoration, and operational coverage. Flexibility and availability outside of normal business hours are essential requirements of this position.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**
  
**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the end-to-end lifecycle of major incidents, from identification and declaration through service restoration and closure.
* Assess incident impact and urgency, validate escalation criteria, and facilitate appropriate major incident designation.
* Serve as the central coordination point for major incident response activities across technical teams and business stakeholders.
* Initiate, facilitate, and manage major incident bridges, ensuring appropriate participation, structure, and progress.
* Coordinate technical resolver groups, monitor investigation activities, track action items, and identify barriers to resolution.
* Facilitate prioritization, escalation, and resource coordination to support timely service restoration.
* Ensure incident records, timelines, decisions, actions, and status updates are accurately maintained in ServiceNow.
* Coordinate timely and consistent communications with IT leadership, business stakeholders, affected departments, and other impacted audiences.
* Partner with Major Incident Process Owner and Communications Managers to ensure communications are accurate, appropriate, and delivered according to established standards.
* Monitor incident progress and provide status updates, escalation notifications, and executive summaries as appropriate.
* Ensure appropriate handoffs between Major Incident Management, Incident Management, and Problem Management.
* Participate in and facilitate post-incident reviews (PIRs), documenting lessons learned, response effectiveness, and improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with the Problem Manager on root cause analysis (RCA), corrective actions, and follow-up activities.
* Ensure outstanding action items and follow-up activities are documented, assigned, and tracked through completion.
* Maintain adherence to established ITIL practices, operational procedures, escalation guidelines, and communication standards.
* Support continual improvement by identifying recurring challenges, process gaps, and opportunities to improve major incident response.
* Provide operational support outside of standard business hours, including overnight, weekends, and holidays as required.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Work requires ability to monitor and maintain budget.
* Work requires ability to ensure adherence to all policies and procedures of university.
* Work requires ability to work with confidential information on a daily basis.
* Work requires ability to effectively interpret and apply organizational policies, procedures, and systems.
* Work requires good interpersonal, organizational, supervisory, and analytical skills.
* Work requires demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and exercise decision-making and problem-solving skills.
* Work requires ability to read, write, develop plans, procedures, and coordinate persons and other resources to accomplish goals.
* Work requires ability to communicate clearly.
* Work requires knowledge of personal computers.
* Work may require ability to lead committees as appropriate.
* Work may requires contact with all levels of internal and external personnel and organizations.
